identity.description: Ecwid (Ecwid by Lightspeed) is an ecommerce platform with a REST API, JS storefront API, and webhooks for building apps and templates for merchants.
identity.identity_notes: Sources are official Ecwid developer docs.

auth.oauth_flows: OAuth 2.0 simplified for single-store customizations; custom apps use access tokens directly without authentication flow.
auth.scopes_notes: Access scopes like read_orders and add_payment_method grant app permissions.

access.production_restrictions: Public apps must go through steps to go live for the App Market; free plan upgrade available by email for developers.

api.rate_limits: 600 requests per minute per token; 429 with Retry-After header when exceeded.
api.limitations: Only stores on paid plans can access API.

claims.quote: We use OAuth 2.0 authorization simplified for single-store customizations, JSON-formatted data, and a clear structure.
Only stores on paid plans can access API.
Ecwid REST API allows you to access and manage any store data, payment and shipping methods, and storefront settings.
Ecwid REST API allows you to access and manage any store data, payment and shipping methods, and storefront settings.
We accept up to 600 requests per minute per token .
Ecwid webhooks are automatic real-time notifications for apps about different events in the store.

open_questions: Is there an official Ecwid MCP server? Sources do not mention one.
Are official SDKs provided? Only community libraries are mentioned in navigation.
Do free-plan stores have API access? Sources say only paid plans, with free upgrades by email.
